visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a title screen featuring the text '世界上最罕見的身體特徵' on a dark background. Below the text, a close-up of a human hand is shown with the thumb bent backwards at an extreme angle, highlighted by a bright red arrow pointing to the joint. (2) The scene transitions into a compilation format where various physical traits are displayed. A smile with white teeth is shown to represent the lack of wisdom teeth, followed by an eye chart and a close-up of a smiling woman's cheek showing a deep dimple. Each image is accompanied by numerical statistics. (3) The sequence continues with shots of a hand performing a hitchhiker's thumb, a close-up of Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson raising a single eyebrow, and a side view of a human ear. The lighting is bright and consistent across these disparate shots. (4) Further traits are shown including a foot with a longer second toe (Morton's toe), a close-up of gapped front teeth, and a man's ear moving independently. The camera remains static for most of these close-up shots, focusing on specific body parts like the tongue folded into three lobes or a left-handed person writing. (5) As the rarity increases, shots show a tongue touching a nose, hair whorls on the back of a head, and a palm with distinct lines forming an 'X'. Portraits of a blonde girl and a girl with red hair represent rare hair colors. (6) The final sequence depicts a single transverse palmar crease (simian crease), a woman attempting to lick her own elbow, and a tiny preauricular pit near an ear. (7) The video concludes with a close-up of a purple iris, hands held over the right side of the chest to indicate situs inversus, and a graphic for 'Golden Blood' showing an 'AB-' blood type symbol against a red background.
